formula_or_constant: gallons = L x W x avg_depth x 7.48052 (rect); pi x r^2 x depth x 7.48052 (circular); pi x (L/2) x (W/2) x depth x 7.48052 (oval)
mathematical_basis: Pure solid-geometry volume formulas x an exact physical conversion constant (1 cubic foot = 7.48052 US gallons, a defined physical/mathematical constant, independently verifiable, not an industry convention).
domain_assumption: None -- the oval formula is a standard elliptical-cylinder approximation, a geometric modeling choice, not a chemistry/product assumption.
notes: 7.48052 and 264.17 (m3->gal) both independently verified as standard, exact unit-conversion constants.

mathematical_basis: Derivable from the definition of ppm-by-weight and a water-density constant (1 gallon of water ~ 8.34 lb; 1 lb NaCl / 83,400 lb water in 10,000 gal (10,000 x 8.34 lb/gal) = ~12 ppm) -- reproduced independently this phase and confirmed to match the coded constant (12) within rounding.
domain_assumption: Assumes pool salt is effectively 100% pure NaCl (real product purity is typically ~99%+, a minor, disclosed-by-omission simplification).
source_status: VERIFIED_MATH (independently re-derived this phase, matches within rounding)
